## Purpose

Why is this task needed, and what will it enable?

## Task description

What work needs to be completed? Include the expected deliverable.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Required work has been completed
- [ ] Relevant stakeholders have reviewed it
- [ ] Feedback has been incorporated
- [ ] Final output has been submitted or shared
- [ ] Decisions and follow-up actions have been recorded

## Dependencies or inputs

What is needed from other people, teams or pieces of work?

## Due date

Add the agreed deadline.

## Supporting links

Add any relevant documents, related tickets or background information.
